name: Rwanda Art Museum
subtitle: A museum of contemporary art in Kanombe, about four kilometres from Kigali International Airport, housed in a building once home to two former Rwandan presidents.

facts.label: Renaming
facts.value: Presidential Palace Museum became Rwanda Art Museum on 18 May 2018

facts.label: Status
facts.value: Described in 2018 as the country's only contemporary art museum

facts.label: Building
facts.value: Historic building, home to two former presidents

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Kanombe, about 4 km from the airport

parts.text: A museum of contemporary art in Kanombe, about four kilometres from Kigali International Airport, housed in a building once home to two former Rwandan presidents. It was the Presidential Palace Museum until renamed in May 2018.
